If you don't like being eaten, private servers are free!

🐲 BE A DRAGON 🐲
The newest Dragon simulator where you become a DRAGON!

- Burn down buildings to get stronger
- Burn smaller dragons to earn Cash (and get stronger!)
- Open eggs to unlock unique Dragon Skins (each with their own unique set of effects)
- Trade Dragon Skins with other players

Premium benefits: Premium players get +100 starting Coins

New updates weekly! Follow the game so you don't miss out!

LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group for FREE +5,000 SIZE
